title: Mutant vs Mutate
script: This is a Mutant. This is a Mutate. So what's the difference? Most people think Spider-Man and Wolverine are both mutants. They're not. Mutants are born with an active X-Gene, naturally unlocking superpowers during puberty. A Mutate is born ordinary, but gains superhuman powers after exposure to external radiation, lab accidents, or genetic experiments. One is born special, the other is altered later in life. That's why Wolverine was born a hero, while Spider-Man was made by a bite. Follow for more.
